description: This PHP source file defines the 'Screen' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_screen' database table. It includes properties such as id, name, actionUrl, module, menuConfigurator, and its associated screenPermissions collection, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Screen
classes.description: Represents a UI screen entity in the OrangeHRM system, including properties such as id, name, URL, associated module, menu configuration, and permissions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the screen.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the screen.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the screen.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the screen.

methods.name: getActionUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the screen's action.

methods.name: setActionUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL associated with the screen's action.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the Module entity associated with the screen.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Associates a Module entity with the screen.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Returns the collection of permissions for this screen.

methods.name: setScreenPermissions
methods.description: Sets the permissions collection for this screen.
